data.name: White Glint
data.description:
White Glint is a sleek and modern 10 meter tall, Middle Weight, all white NEXT, a armored core equipped with cutting edge Kojima technology, built with high-speed combat in mind. NEXTs are also equipped with a revolutionary new piloting system, called Allegorical Manipulation System, which allows for astounding 1:1 lightning fast manipulation. The NEXT also transforms for certain actions: during Over Boost, a myriad of boosters extend and open, and the head sinks into the torso; when activating its Assault Armor, the craft's frame expands and certain parts gain additional armor, these transformations happen very fast. White Glint also possesses many glowing blue compact optical "eyes" on the sides of its head, these serve as optical feeds.

White Glint is armed with two BFF-manufactured rifles: the 051ANNR on the right hand, and the 063ANAR on the other, they're made to be as NEXT sized so they're sized in 51mm and 63mm respectively. White Glint is equipped with two SALINE05 spread missiles on its shoulders, the spread missiles have great lock on and fire in salvos.

White Glint also possesses several boosters, the main boosters, side boosters, Over boosters and back boosters to be specific. White Glint is special in the fact it has 26 total boosters when it goes into Over Boost, the main boosters are 12 and the Overed Boosters are 14. the Overed boosters are arranged in two rectangular blocks when they're folded, and unfold to resemble 'wings' in the most loose term, as they become two lines instead of rectangles. the main boosters however are a two folded smaller rectangular blocks that fold out like a rope. the engines when firing in Over Boost have a insanely long white flame shooting from the nozzles.  

Kojima particles are green particles that remain airborne for long periods of time. NEXTs are able to use Kojima particles as a spherical force-field around the NEXT by trapping the particles, As an object passes through the field, its energy compresses the particles in front of it to a solid state, a foreign object is meant to be halted by the solid wall of kojima, or even destroyed by the Kojima particles' habit of rapidly eroding through solid matter that come into contact, and thus it was called "Primal Armor". however Kojima Particles prove to very dangerous to life, being extremely radioactive and highly polluting, and thus NEXTs do not use their Primal Armor in populated areas, Kojima Particles can reach ranges of over 5 kilometers. 

Kojima Particles, When applied to boosters, they allow both Quick Boosting, which give NEXTs bursts of speed surpassing the 1000 km/h mark to become blurs of steel and color, compared to Normal's plodding speed, and Over boosting, letting NEXTs traverse large distances with ease.

Kojima Particles can also be used as a offensive weapon, dubbed "Assault Armor". Assault Armor allowed a unit to expend its Kojima particle shielding to create a 360 degree explosion around the unit. Doing so completely depleted the unit's and any surrounding units Primal Armor, but resulting in devastating damage around the unit.

White Glint is not a AI, and is instead a piece of Equipment and so as such does not have a onboard AI, and if it would have a system voice then it'd be for stuff such as ammo reminders and missile lock only.

AP refers to armor points, LA refers to left arm, RA refers to right arm, LB refers to left back, RB refers to right back.
